content: The individual can be contacted via email. They completed their medical education at Baqai Medical University. They are a registered general practitioner in Pakistan. Since April 2021, they have been volunteering as a WikiDoc scholar. From May 2018 to January 2019, they worked as a medical officer specializing in pediatric oncology at The Indus Hospital in Karachi, Pakistan. Between March 2015 and February 2016, they participated in an internship program at Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre in Karachi, Pakistan. Since 2010, they have been a member of the organization Unified Liaison for Promotion of Health and Advanced Treatment (ULPHAT) in Pakistan.
